earthquake_early.japanese_phrase: 緊急地震速報 (Kinkyu Jishin Sokuhou)
earthquake_early.description: Phones and TV issue rapid repeating tones ("Ponyon, Ponyon") followed by: "Kinkyū Jishin Sokuhō desu. Tsuyoi yure ni keikai shite kudasai". Protect your head immediately.

tsunami_warning.description: Coastal sirens sound (3s blast, 2s pause). Evacuate immediately to high ground or a Tsunami Evacuation Building.

evacuation_order.description: Level 4 Alert. Everyone in designated hazard zones must evacuate to a shelter immediately.
